company.name: Haiku
company.shortDescription: Haiku is revolutionizing legal practice by placing artificial intelligence and data at the service of law.
company.description: Haiku is revolutionizing legal practice by placing artificial intelligence and data at the service of law. The company's objective is to free lawyers from tedious research and writing tasks to assist them in all of their work and thus increase their productivity while preserving their expertise.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered platform that analyzes legal documents, extracts key information, and cross-references relevant jurisprudence and regulations to support legal argumentation and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: Haiku AI Legal Research and Document Analysis

productsAndServices.description: A centralized document management feature that organizes, stores, and allows easy access to legal documents within the Haiku platform.
productsAndServices.name: Haiku Document Library (Bibliothèque)

productsAndServices.description: A tool that extracts specific clauses or data points from multiple legal documents into customizable tables for detailed analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Haiku Data Extraction (Extract)

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven drafting assistant that generates, adapts, corrects, and translates legal documents based on user input and existing documents.
productsAndServices.name: Haiku AI-Assisted Drafting (Rédaction assistée)

productsAndServices.description: A service that connects Haiku to users' electronic document management systems to synchronize and leverage existing legal documents and expertise.
productsAndServices.name: Haiku Integration with Document Management Systems (GED)

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $3,406,215, or 71.3% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,100,879 to $18,120,245, a 1.79x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 90 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 33 (+21).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Luminance, Harvey, Spellbook.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
